**LiveRamp Press Release and Frequently Asked Questions (PRFAQ) Template**

**External and Internal FAQs**

Q: What is the solution or solution update?  
The XMI refresh agent is the central orchestrator that pulls together the information and the actions that a user needs to create high frequency XMI report refreshes. 

At a high level, it pulls together Clean Room QA information, report configurations and boosted QA into a central place so that TSOLs can quickly identify issues. It also allows users to make updates to report configurations and kick off runs. It will ultimately also include Report QA outputs as part of the process as well. 

Q: Who is the target customer/persona?  
The current customer is XMI TSOLs who perform managed service operations for XMI Customers. With the Refresh Agent, we believe non-XMI TSOLs and customers themselves could produce XMI reporting since a lot of the endemic knowledge and understanding of the system can be built into the agent itself. 

Q: What products or solutions does the target customer use today to solve this problem?   
Today users leverage the MCS UI as well as logging into the LiveRamp clean room to configure reports and pull together information. The Refresh Agent will be deployed within the MCS UI and be a copilot for users hoping to setup high frequency reporting.  

Q: What problem(s) does this solution solve for customers?

* “I dont want to wait 18 days post-campaign for my reporting, why cant it be done faster”  
* “Why does it take so long to catch issues with upstream data assets”   
* “Your competitors are producing daily or weekly reporting”

Q: How does this proposed product solution create value for customers? i.e., In what way(s) is this solution better, cheaper, and faster than the alternatives?  
By consolidating all QA into a central place with alerting, we can ensure that operators are aware of upstream data issues immediately, thus saving time post-campaing on troubleshooting. In addition, for customers who are not radically changing their campaign structure from run to run, this agent can help adjust dates, check mapping, and make tweaks to measurement plans so that reports can be produced quickly. 

The goal of the measurement agent is to allow reports to be produced within a 5 day SLA instead of an 18 day SLA. 

Q: What is the workflow?

1. Clean Room QA is running daily in the background. When the user logs in, we will pull in any anomalies that are found and present them to the user from the last 7 days  
   1. The agent knows you ran last month and are on a monthly cadence, so we will serve up failures or alerts from BQA for the time period of your active reports   
2. Then you can prompt to create a new report plan, the default will be to clone the previous report plan  
   1. It will then serve up options for what you want to change in the newly cloned report plan   
   2. If you try to change something beyond what a report plan could do, it could suggest you create a new Measurement Plan  
   3. It should have the context of the cadence of measurement and suggest the updating of dates   
   4. Agent then kicks off input summaries once the user is ready  
3. Once input summaries are run, the agent will surface mapping gaps that it has found across publishers   
   1. Links to the maps in question will be provided and the user can go to Value Mapping App and correct these or download and run through Datalinx  
4. Now maps are ready, user prompts agent to run BQA  
   1. Agent delivers BQA results in the format of the warnings system around BQA agent that we have already built  
5. Once user approves BQA (with prompt in agent flow), user can prompt to run report   
   1. The user should also have the ability to drop in business questions that the user wants to answer so that we can continue testing our dynamic Habu Intelligence dashboards that are organized by business question   
6. User is alerted when reports are done and can see outputs in Habu Intel

Q: How does the customer utilize the solution?  
Customer logs into MCS and is greeted with a pop-up chat window that proactively has pulled in CR QA from that day and the previous 7 days to start the above workflow. 

Q: What are the implementation and support steps to configure and maintain this solution?  
No implementation needed, this is part of MCS platform. 

Q: What are the known issues and limitations?  
Limitations: 

* Does not yet include Results QA (post-campaign reporting) but that will add value when we have it   
* Does not have workflows that support new measurement plan creation, only report creation  
* May not have alerting that pings into Slack or another external source outside MCS  
* Does not guide the user to solve the problems that arise when anomalies are detected in the QA, that would be a good add-on feature

Q: What is the estimated timeline, including release stages and any upcoming enhancements?  
Ideally CSE team using the system end to end by the end of the quarter on a live, shadow client deliverable  
Next quarter, TSOPs team begins using it for production deliveries 

Q: What resources are available to support this solution?  
Team of 4 engineering resources across front-end and back-end  
Dedicated CSE resource to testing and doing first production runs

Customers who want shorter-cadence reporting, specifically:
